title: Tim Minchin - If You Open Your Mind Too Much...
summary: A short live performance of Tim Minchin's comedic song about skepticism, from his DVD 'So Live'. It argues that open-mindedness shouldn't go so far that your brain falls out.
why: HN commenters cite it as a quick, witty reference whenever someone warns against being so open-minded that you become gullible.

quote.text: you need to have an open mind, but be careful to not your brain fall off
